title: dioscorea glandulosa var. calcensis
intro: Dioscorea glandulosa var. calcensis, commonly known as a type of yam, is a plant species from the family Dioscoreaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in reducing stress and alleviating symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Dioscorea glandulosa var. calcensis include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-osteoporotic effects due to its high content of saponins, a group of bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a steroid saponin with potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
